mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with enalapril (ACE inhibitor) increases risk of severe hypertension, hypertensive crisis, and serotonergic effects due to impaired catecholamine metabolism and ACE inhibitor-mediated bradykinin accumulation.
action: Avoid this combination; if both agents are necessary, use alternative antidepressant or antihypertensive; monitor blood pressure closely if coadministration unavoidable and ensure adequate washout period between drugs.
